newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY FIRMS VS BASKET AMID C.BANK DLR-SELLING.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY FIRMS VS BASKET AMID C.BANK DLR-SELLING.

text.p: 1230 GMT - The zloty closed at -2.84/-2.94 pct from the trading band centre vs Friday's -3.30/-3.37 pct as a light currency-selling trend formed probably on the back of small central bank interventions. However dealers confirmed only one c.bank intervention at 3.4685, or about -3.02 pct from parity.
* It closed at 3.4650/80 to the dollar, against 3.4850/55 on Friday and at 1.9315/35 to the mark, against 1.9365/90.

* O/N end flat from opening at 23.30/23.70 pct and T/N slip slightly to close at 23.65/23.95. Investors bid for 1.08 bln zlotys of Polish T-bills at the trasury's 1.1 billion zloty primary auction. Tender results due out shortly.
